title: First-Line Supervisors of Correctional Officers
description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of correctional officers and jailers.

tasks.text: Take, receive, or check periodic inmate counts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical counting of bodies in a facility

tasks.text: Maintain order, discipline, and security within assigned areas in accordance with relevant rules, regulations, policies, and laws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical force and weapons in unpredictable confrontations

dwas.name: Use weapons or physical force to maintain security.

tasks.text: Maintain knowledge of, comply with, and enforce all institutional policies, rules, procedures, and regulations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI supports study; certification requires human

tasks.text: Respond to emergencies, such as escapes.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Emergency response needs physical action in the world

dwas.name: Respond to emergencies to provide assistance.

tasks.text: Supervise and direct the work of correctional officers to ensure the safe custody, discipline, and welfare of inmates.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Correctional facility direction is high-stakes human authority

tasks.text: Supervise or perform searches of inmates or their quarters to locate contraband items.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Spotting suspicious objects needs physical visual search

dwas.name: Search individuals for illegal or dangerous items.

tasks.text: Monitor behavior of subordinates to ensure alert, courteous, and professional behavior toward inmates, parolees, fellow employees, visitors, and the public.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Restrain, secure, or control offenders, using chemical agents, firearms, or other weapons of force as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical force and weapons in unpredictable confrontations

dwas.name: Use weapons or physical force to maintain security.

tasks.text: Carry injured offenders or employees to safety and provide emergency first aid when necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering first aid requires physical intervention

tasks.text: Complete administrative paperwork or supervise the preparation or maintenance of records, forms, or reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Supervise activities, such as searches, shakedowns, riot control, or institutional tours.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Correctional facility direction is high-stakes human authority

tasks.text: Conduct roll calls of correctional officers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical counting of bodies in a facility

tasks.text: Instruct employees or provide on-the-job training.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live instruction and hands-on coaching require human presence

dwas.name: Train employees in proper work procedures.

tasks.text: Resolve problems between inmates.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live conflict resolution needs presence and trust

dwas.name: Resolve interpersonal conflicts.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Set up employee work schedules.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routine schedule generation from stated constraints

dwas.name: Prepare activity or work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Examine incoming or outgoing mail to ensure conformance with regulations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Policy compliance document review, human owns final call

dwas.name: Review documents or materials for compliance with policies or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Transfer or transport offenders on foot or by driving vehicles, such as trailers, vans, or buses.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles to transport people/equipment

dwas.name: Escort prisoners to courtrooms, prisons, or other facilities.
Drive vehicles to transport individuals or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Review offender information to identify issues that require special attention.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reading and deriving actions from text is core LLM

dwas.name: Read materials to determine needed actions.

tasks.text: Develop work or security procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Procedures drafted; human validates feasibility

tasks.text: Convey correctional officers' or inmates' complaints to superiors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Performance and complaint discussions carry accountability

dwas.name: Discuss performance, complaints, or violations with supervisors.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Supervise or provide security for offenders performing tasks, such as construction, maintenance, laundry, food service, or other industrial or agricultural operations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Inmate supervision is physical, situated, accountability-bearing

tasks.text: Conduct evaluations of employees' performance.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Rate behavior of inmates, promoting acceptable attitudes and behaviors to those with low ratings.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Inmate supervision is physical, situated, accountability-bearing
